outcome: Prevalence of disrespect and abuse during childbirth
Factors associated with disrespect and abuse
cohort: 1528 women surveyed within 48 hours of live delivery at 14 hospitals in Peru
finding: Nearly all participants (97.4%) experienced at least one category of disrespect and abuse during childbirth, with type of delivery, being referred, and geographic region being associated factors.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with increased frequency of abandonment of care, but lower frequency of physical abuse compared to vaginal delivery.
cross-section timing: within 48 hours of live delivery between April and July 2016
